title: Design: database providers, access levels and vault-based credentials for connection storage
author: SmearODeer
body_snippet:
Follow-up to #3249, as discussed there. This issue is for agreeing on a design before anyone writes code. Everything below is a proposal; please correct or reject any part of it.

## Goal (from #3249)

- Admins define named database servers ("providers"), for example DEV-TEST and PROD.
- No passwords are stored in profiles or settings, only a reference to a secret in a vault.
- Users without a vault get a basic local store, encrypted for the machine (section 2 proposes per user instead).
